p.i: Poscit sæpe suum: te rogat ut tuos
Soleris gemitus, dum timet, heu! tibi.
Tristis te revocat: teque bonos sibi
Segnes tolle moras: ocyus ut mihi
Bezæ nostra placent, vatum celeberrimus ille est.
Nil mihi nunc tecum, liuida turba, vale.

page.notes: Ornamental double rule above "AD ZOILOS." Faint show-through from the reverse page in the right margin, not transcribed. Verse lines are set as printed; some letters are blurred in the scan (e.g. "Dalmontia", "Ambrosiæ"), read as best as possible.
